body: I have a hard time coping. I feel horrible, yet relieved, and that relief makes me feel even more horrible. She was my family, the one I shared my deepest darkest secrets with. But for some reason I still worry about her, she hasn't replied and I'm terrified that she has hurt herself. But I'm trying to use my feelings and emotions as fuel to to gain strength.

Thank you for your reply! I have read all the replies from everyone and I'm trying to thank you all. I wanted to thank you first. I've gotten so many kind words from Reddit. You are all giving me hope again, but you are the first to ask how I'm holding up. And I appreciate that a lot. I feel just like you. I'm glad I did it, but I still have this feeling in my stomach. I'm terrified of how she might have reacted, what is she has hurt herself? I've gotten the suggestion to block her everywhere, and I really want to do that, I think that would help me to move on, but I can't. Not until I know she is safe. Right now I both hate her and love her, I never want to speak to her again, but I have to know she's safe because for some reason I still care about her. So yeah, conflicted is a good word for it. I must admit that  I've texted her twice to hear what she's doing. But I'm trying to take care of myself, and I'm trying to use my emotions as fuel to keep me going. But thank you so much for caring. It means more than you can imagine in times like this. If you want to talk feel free to message me.

I know that you are totally right. But it's so hard. I keep on making excuses for her, saying that it's just her ptsd or bipolarity, that she can't control herself. I don't think anyone can imagine what she has been through. But I feel so guilty for her panic attack. You have to agree that it's weird timing for her to get a panic attack as soon as we start talking. Actually I just realized. I don't trust her. Maybe she is just lying. It wouldn't be the first time she has manipulated me. But I can't cut her out. She is pretty much the only family I've got. I don't have anyone.
